description: This file defines the FeatureDefinitionDeleted event class used within the org.eclipse.ditto.signals.events.things package. It models an event emitted after a feature's definition is deleted in a thing, providing methods for creation, JSON serialization/deserialization, and equality checks.

classes.name: FeatureDefinitionDeleted
classes.description: Immutable event class representing the deletion of a feature's definition in a thing, with JSON serialization/deserialization capabilities, and methods to modify revision, headers, and provide resource path.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create an instance with given parameters, including optional metadata.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Constructs an instance from a JSON string or JSON object, along with headers.

methods.name: getFeatureId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the feature whose definition was deleted.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Provides the JSON pointer to the resource path for the event payload.

methods.name: setRevision
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified revision.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified headers.
